_note: 學習路徑內容建置第10批 #1／6：過去簡單式 vs 過去進行式（eng.t_mid.verb.past-when-while，會考級／中階）。過去進行式（was/were＋-ing）＝過去某刻正在進行、當背景；過去簡單式＝已完成、通常較短的動作。while 多接進行中的長背景（While I was cooking…）、when 多接打斷的短動作（…when the phone rang）。誘答以『時態不一致／進行式配突發短動作』等結構鎖唯一正解，避免 while＋過去簡單這種口語兩可（故 while 題的誘答不放過去簡單）。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix pww_）。

units.title_zh: 過去簡單 vs 過去進行（when 接短動作／while 接背景）
units.can_do: 我能用過去進行式（was/were＋-ing）說過去某刻正在進行的背景動作，用過去簡單式說已完成的短動作，並知道 while 多接進行中的長背景、when 多接打斷的短動作：I was cooking when the phone rang。
units.situation_group: 過去時態 Past simple vs past continuous
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The past continuous (was/were + verb-ing) describes an action that was in progress at a past moment; it sets the background: 'At eight o'clock I was doing my homework'.
claims.verification_ref: 過去進行式 was/were＋-ing＝過去某刻正在進行的背景；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The past simple describes a completed action, often a short one: 'The phone rang', 'It started to rain'.
claims.verification_ref: 過去簡單式＝已完成、通常較短的動作；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'while' usually introduces the longer background action that was in progress, so it often goes with the past continuous: 'While I was listening to music, ...'.
claims.verification_ref: while 多接進行中的長背景、搭過去進行式；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'when' usually introduces the short action that happens or interrupts, so it often goes with the past simple: '... when the doorbell rang'.
claims.verification_ref: when 多接打斷的短動作、搭過去簡單式；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The common pattern puts the long background action in the past continuous and the short interrupting action in the past simple: 'I was reading when the lights went out'.
claims.verification_ref: 長背景用過去進行式＋短打斷用過去簡單式；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: There are two common tenses for talking about the past: the past progressive (was/were + -ing) shows an action in progress at one moment, as the background; the past simple (the past form of the verb) shows a finished, usually shorter action.
teach.zh_hint: 說過去的事有兩種常用時態：過去進行式（was/were ＋ -ing）表示『過去某一刻正在進行』、當背景；過去簡單式（動詞過去式）表示『已經完成、通常較短』的動作。

teach.body: At nine o'clock last night, I was doing my homework.
teach.zh_hint: 昨晚九點我正在寫功課。was doing 是過去某刻正在進行的背景。

teach.body: A common pattern: while is followed by the long background action in progress (past progressive), and when is followed by the short action that interrupts it (past simple). While I was walking to school, it started to rain = I was walking to school when it started to rain.
teach.zh_hint: 常見搭配：while 後面接進行中的長背景（用過去進行式），when 後面接打斷它的短動作（用過去簡單式）。While I was walking to school, it started to rain＝I was walking to school when it started to rain（我正走路上學，突然下起雨）。

teach.body: While I was taking a shower, the phone rang.
teach.zh_hint: 我正在洗澡時，電話響了。背景 was taking a shower 用進行式、打斷的 rang 用過去簡單。

teach.body: The when clause can also come later: I was reading a book when the lights went out. Tip: use was/were + -ing for the long background action, and the past simple for the short action that suddenly interrupts it.
teach.zh_hint: when 子句也可以放後面：I was reading a book when the lights went out（我正在看書，燈突然熄了）。訣竅：長的、當背景的那個動作用 was/were＋-ing；短的、突然發生打斷的那個用過去簡單式。

teach.body: I was reading a book when the lights suddenly went out.
teach.zh_hint: 我正在看書，燈突然熄了。was reading 是背景、went out 是突發的短動作。

practice.stem: 選出正確動詞形式：We were playing outside when it suddenly ____ to rain.（我們正在外面玩，突然開始下雨）

distractor_rationales.was starting: 『突然發生、短暫』的動作用過去簡單式 started；進行式 was starting 表『正在開始的過程』，與 suddenly 不合。
distractor_rationales.starts: starts 是現在式，與過去背景 were playing 時態不一致。
distractor_rationales.start: start 是原形，這裡需要過去式。

practice.feedback: 突然打斷的短動作用過去簡單式：…when it suddenly started to rain。

practice.stem: 選出正確動詞形式：While I ____ to music, I fell asleep.（我聽音樂聽到睡著）

distractor_rationales.listen: listen 是原形／現在式，不能表過去正在進行的背景。
distractor_rationales.listens: listens 是第三人稱現在式，與過去背景時態不一致。
distractor_rationales.will listen: will listen 是未來式；過去進行中的背景用 was listening。

practice.feedback: while 接進行中的長背景，用過去進行式：While I was listening to music…。

practice.stem: 在 'The lights went out while we were watching a movie' 裡，哪一部分是進行中的『長背景』動作？

distractor_rationales.The lights went out: 燈熄掉是突然打斷的『短動作』（過去簡單 went out），不是進行中的長背景。
distractor_rationales.went out: went out 本身是短動作的動詞，不是進行中的背景。
distractor_rationales.the lights: the lights 是名詞主詞，不是『進行中的動作』。

practice.feedback: we were watching a movie（過去進行式）是進行中的長背景。

practice.stem: 選出表達「我正在睡覺時，鬧鐘響了」的句子：
practice.answer: I was sleeping when the alarm rang.
options: I was sleeping when the alarm rang.
I slept when the alarm rang.
I was sleeping when the alarm was ringing.
I slept when the alarm was ringing.

slept 是過去簡單，表『鬧鐘響時我才去睡』，不合『正在睡覺』的背景意思。
distractor_rationales.I was sleeping when the alarm was ringin: 鬧鐘響是突然打斷的短動作，用過去簡單 rang，不用進行式。
時態用反了——背景該用進行式 was sleeping、打斷該用過去簡單 rang。

practice.feedback: 背景用過去進行式＋打斷用過去簡單：I was sleeping when the alarm rang。

practice.stem: 填入正確的連接詞：The baby was sleeping quietly ____ someone suddenly knocked loudly on the door.（寶寶正安靜睡著，有人突然用力敲門）

distractor_rationales.while: while 用來接『進行中的背景』（was sleeping 已是背景）；接『突然打斷的短動作 suddenly knocked』用 when（while 配突發的短動作不自然）。
distractor_rationales.because: because 表原因，不合這裡『正在睡時突然被打斷』的時間關係。
distractor_rationales.before: before 表『在…之前』；這裡是『正在睡時被打斷』＝when。

practice.feedback: 突然打斷的短動作用 when 帶出：…when someone suddenly knocked loudly。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: While we were waiting for the bus, it suddenly started to rain.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：背景用過去進行式 were waiting 有沒有寫對、突發的短動作 started（過去簡單）有沒有寫對，while／suddenly 有沒有漏，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。背景句 was/were＋-ing 連貫唸出、突發短動作稍重，句尾下收。

lines.text: I was reading a book when the lights went out.
lines.intonation: was reading a book 連貫、when the lights went out 稍停、句尾下收

lines.text: While she was cooking dinner, her phone rang.
lines.intonation: While she was cooking dinner 連貫、her phone rang 稍重、句尾下收
